conditions.runtime: Actual completed consumption of assigned edible item or successful native Cookery FoodBiteBlock portion; server player only

change.summary: Curated per-item tiers/families use exact approved utility matrix; one native food contribution bundle and five-ID dietary movement bonus.

before.value: Native food properties/effects only; no JEM quality bundle

after.mapping: Each exact item stores tier, family, exact vanilla effect IDs/amplifiers and native duration; 1/2/3 components; atomically replaces prior food contributions.

after.time_source: overworld.getGameTime; does not follow dayTime, sleep or /time set

before.value: Vanilla stores one native active instance per effect ID and a source-blind hidden chain

after.strategy: Existing independent same-ID effect wins until natural expiry; narrow pre-add native hook detaches only exact owned instance before external merge. Never snapshots/restores independent effects. Native direct forceAddEffect/map writes/raw absorption changes are unsupported source-ownership bypasses.

before.value: Native repeated effect insertion grants full absorption capacity

after.value: Persistent spent absorption and active native budget window carry across bundle replacement, intervening nonabsorption dish, logout and death; insertion only grants unspent allowance. Raw absorption with no effect defers insertion.

rationale.purpose: Reward deliberate cooking and variety while preserving vanilla staples, independent native sources and boss combat balance.
rationale.user_requested: User supplied tier durations/effect matrix, one-bundle policy, independent-effect preservation and five distinct IDs/+5% movement rule.
rationale.codex_choices: Exact recipe-backed assignments, conservative independent-effect precedence, pre-add ownership Mixin, native Cookery successful-bite adapter and persisted absorption debt are implementation choices. No recipes or native food properties changed.

introduced.summary: Exact recipe-backed food assignments, one attributable native effect bundle and persistent active-server-time variety.

history.summary: Exact recipe-backed food assignments, one attributable native effect bundle and persistent active-server-time variety.

relations: Original installed recipe facts are preserved as evidence in the change-owned assignment set; no competing registry is introduced.
Catalog/changes/food-quality-assignments.json is the single assignment authority, projected unchanged into JAR data/jemcompat/food_quality.json.
Tooltip localization is client-side, effect insertion and dietary timestamps are server-side.
Native quality NBT, hunger/saturation, recipes, containers and remainder behavior remain owned by installed mods.
notes: 123 exact classified IDs across six measured cooking modules; 129 exclusions and unresolved native recipe outputs listed in Docs/food/COVERAGE.md.
All player-facing durations use Minecraft days while internal native units remain unchanged.
Food bundle clears on actual death; dietary timestamps and spent absorption debt survive clone.
unresolved: Player acceptance/runtime behavior remains unverified; no tests or gameplay launches requested.
Same-ID external source temporarily replaces food contribution even if weaker/shorter; food resumes only within remaining lifetime.
Direct third-party forceAddEffect, native effect-map writes and raw absorption changes while food owns absorption bypass the audited pre-add route and cannot provide general source ownership.
Generic third-party placed cakes/portion routes and other pack namespaces are not exhaustively classified.
